parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

- If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html, check the CasterId parameter value returned by the CreateCaster operation.

- If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, navigate to **ApsaraVideo Live console** > **Production Studios** > **Cloud Production Studio** to view the production studio name.

> The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page of the ApsaraVideo Live console is the production studio ID.


The production studio must meet the following configurations:
- **NormType**: **3**. Create a lightweight carousel production studio in advance. You can call the **CreateCaster** operation to create a production studio.
- **CasterTemplate**: lp_noTranscode.
- **channelEnable**: 0.
- **programEffect**: 1
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**路径查看导播台名称。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。


导播台需满足如下配置：
- **NormType**：**3**。您需要提前创建好轻量级轮播型的导播台，可以调用**CreateCaster**接口创建导播台。
- **CasterTemplate**：lp_noTranscode。
- **channelEnable**：0。
- **programEffect**：1
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The list of playlist item inputs. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see **InputProgramItem**
parameters.help_zh: 节目单项输入列表。为JSON字符串，更多信息，请参见**InputProgramItem**
parameters.name: program_items

parameters.help_en: The playlist ID. If the production studio already has a playlist, you must specify the corresponding ProgramId. If no playlist has been created, you can leave this parameter empty, and the system performs automatic creation
parameters.help_zh: 节目单ID。若导播台已存在节目单，则必须传入对应的 ProgramId；若从未创建过节目单，可不填，系统将自动创建
parameters.name: program_id

parameters.help_en: The playlist item configuration. If this is the first time you add a playlist item, specify this parameter for initialization. For more information, see **ProgramConfig**
parameters.help_zh: 节目单项配置。若首次添加，传该参数进行初始化配置。更多信息，请参见**ProgramConfig**
parameters.name: program_config
